**untested** (not refittable) · `grossular_angel_2022_bm3_q_compromise_debye` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/grossular.md#record-grossular_angel_2022_bm3_q_compromise_debye)

**Scope:** Reconstruction of a source equation or calculation. **Basis:** Published parameterization verified by independent quadrature and official EosFit checks; complete original joint fit is unavailable.

- Covariance is source-reported and conditional; no original-fit coefficient or formal-uncertainty reproduction is claimed.
